payload.description: Performance figures in a form anyone can check. Norwich publishes a full set of targets and actuals every quarter, which is more than many district councils manage. But the numbers live in Appendix A of the report as screenshots of a dashboard, not as text or a spreadsheet, so they cannot be searched, copied or checked by machine. Every target measure on this site was read off those images by eye. The council also runs a live Power BI dashboard on its website, which is a JavaScript embed and cannot be archived either.
